headline: Trackers estimate $4.86 million left Chainflip’s Ethereum vault, and AP and CNN report an apparent intrusion into the FBI’s national crime database. Reproduced Microsoft customer notices describe unauthorized access to Entra Connect Health tenant metadata; the affected count is unknown.

incidents.what: Chainflip paused deposits, withdrawals and swaps while investigating an Ethereum vault outflow that trackers estimated at $4.86 million.
CNN and the Associated Press reported an apparent intrusion into the FBI’s national crime database; the bureau has not publicly confirmed the intrusion or its scope.
Microsoft customer notices reproduced publicly say outsiders read administrator email addresses and tenant metadata through a flaw that Microsoft fixed server-side.
CISA confirmed that attackers are exploiting a vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver.
incidents.scale: Known exploited vulnerability; victim count not disclosed

incidents.what: Nissan suspended part of its global dealer diagnostics system after detecting unauthorized access, delaying some repairs and replacement-key programming.
Staples Canada said unauthorized access at its print website exposed contact information, order summaries and encrypted passwords.
incidents.scale: Count not disclosed; no financial data reported exposed

incidents.what: Optimizely shut down a legacy deployment server and removed an injected script from two sites after finding unauthorized access.
Eskenazi Health disclosed that patient information may have been accessed after two employee email accounts were compromised in September.
New reporting cited an unverified $95.35 million loss tally for the October wallet-tampering incident; Ledger confirmed an implant in one device.
A USDA undersecretary confirmed a cyberthreat and said no data was lost, while press reports describe suspected access to a farm-payment system.
incidents.scale: Loans and payments disrupted; access scope unconfirmed

incidents.what: Travelsoft confirmed a cyberattack on its Orchestra booking platform and began restoring services used by French travel agencies.
Rokkatei expanded the potential scope of its online-shop breach to customer contact details and reported one confirmed case of fraudulent card use.
